india.one_line: India’s defence AI collaboration and Freshworks’ acquisition boost AI adoption in security and IT services.

themes.title: Sarvam AI partners with defence
themes.text: Sarvam AI signed a five‑year memorandum of understanding with the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff of India’s Ministry of Defence to design, develop and deploy AI for operational, training and decision‑support needs across the Army, Navy and Air Force, using shared foundation models and infrastructure.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications

themes.title: Freshworks acquires Israeli AI startup
themes.text: Freshworks bought Israel‑based AI startup Robusta Dev, adding AI‑driven incident investigation, outage diagnosis and remediation recommendations to its Freshservice IT service‑management platform.

stories.headline: Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to Freshservice
Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to boost incident management
